written_before: any unsigned-variant cell existed (0 unsigned cells on disk); 83 factorial cells existed; no analysis output in results/

changes.why: under the unsigned variant of a BLOCK format, codebook.supports_unsigned returned True for that format, so B2's boundary analysis marked non-negative rows 'unsigned' and blocks.block_plan refused the plan (ValueError 'unsigned boundary in a shared-exponent plan', queue r1, resnet18 unsigned block group). Fixed: supports_unsigned is patched for scalar formats only; block formats get their unsigned activation blocks from blocks_unsigned.prepare_blocks via plan['nonnegative'] exactly as the protocol states. Regression test test_unsigned_variant_keeps_block_plan_signed.
changes.effect_on_cells: none computed before the fix (the failing job wrote no cell); the unsigned-variant identity carries the hashes of cells.py/unsigned.py/blocks_unsigned.py, so every unsigned cell is identified with the fixed source

changes.why: measured peak 4.8-4.9 GB allocated for bias-correction scalar cells on MobileNetV2 (non-BC 0.5 GB); a ResNet18 BC scalar cell and a ResNet18 BC block cell died of CUDA OOM at the light admission
changes.rule: scalar cells with bias correction: gpu_run.sh --heavy 6000, grouped per model and part up to 36 cells; scalar without: --min-free-mib 4500; blocks as before; a failed group is retried once with --heavy 8000. No effect on any result (deterministic cells, identities unchanged).

changes.finding: artifacts/experiment_b2/runs/* hold default_no_bias_correction, default_weight_maxabs and default_signed records whose configuration identities equal those of cells in this plan, but they carry no per-image readout (top-1/top-5 only), so they cannot enter paired statistics. They are used as a reproduction cross-check: run metrics.top1_percent must equal the cell's readout top1_topk_percent (runs-crosscheck.csv).

items: chance flag: the protocol clause 'both formats below 1 percent under either recipe' cannot hold for a reversal beyond 1 pp; it is read as: a reversal is flagged chance_pair when EITHER format is below 1 percent under EITHER of the two recipes (stricter; such reversals never count as robust). Counts without the flag are reported too.
the literal-recipe ('searched') views of the block formats form their own tier 'searched' (protocol: sensitivity analysis) and category involves_searched_sensitivity; they are not strong recipes
a recipe view whose X and Y cells are the same records as an earlier view (e.g. default_signed for two non-integer formats) is not compared again (no double counting)
pair-level verdict per (model, class, X, Y): survives_among_strong / minimal_side / maxabs_percentile_only / searched_only / interval_only_with_chance_format / point_only (pair-reversals.csv)
the 7-bit class has one format (fp7_e3m3) and therefore no pair; Kendall/Spearman are computed for classes 8, 6, <=5 and all

percentile-bootstrap intervals of rank correlations can exclude the point estimate when formats tie at chance (resampling breaks exact ties); the above-chance subset is the interpretable one and is reported beside it
